name: Taking Back Silithus
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Attention, champions of the Horde!  There's a threat we've left unchallenged for too long.  Tremors in the earth near silithid hives all around Azeroth have alerted us to large movements in their numbers as they prepare for expansion.

Cenarion Circle forces are gathering in Silithus to take the fight to the silithid before it's too late!  No more shall they defile our lands!

All able-bodied combatants are to report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold!  The silithid shall be vanquished!
narrative.objectives: Talk to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent, a new recruit answering the call to arms against the silithid. Welcome to Cenarion Hold, Champion. I am pleased to see the words of our emissaries are reaching heroes of your caliber. You will find no shortage of opportunities to help us in our efforts here and I expect you'll quickly prove to be a valuable ally to our cause.
